question: On the momentum alert names the operator pays for, does the premarket lane's own live arm (not buying at the alert), with the lane's limit-order and liquidation mechanics, make money after the real SIP spread, beat a random minute on the same name, and earn enough per session to pay for real-time SIP?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-11-06 ~04:45 ET in chat: 'Im good with "make momentum names the main test subject of the SIP premarket month"', then 'Yes, write it' to the offer to write the momentum premarket prereg and SIP replay plan.
registered_at: 2026-11-06 ~05:00 ET, before any code or data pull for this study.
what_was_already_seen: One quick look, 2026-11-06 (running list row 94, /tmp/mom2wk.py): 10 sessions 10/23-11/05, buy the minute after the first alert and hold 30 min, GROSS: premarket $2+ n 86 mean -366 bp, median -168, win 31%; 63% reach +2% within 30 min, 74% touch -2%. That look used buy-at-alert, not the lane's arm. Its sessions are inside this study's window and are NOT excluded (the look did not test the arm). The buy-at-alert result is the 'a' control below, so it is re-measured here under this prereg's fill and cost rules.
prior: Low-to-moderate on the arm, low on economics. For: premarket alerts move a lot (most reach +2%). Against: buy-at-alert fades (-366 bp/30m gross); 106 premarket mention bursts 8/24-9/26 faded from peak to open (-1.8% median); momentum under ideal data netted -15 bp in RTH (9/25); premarket spreads are wide. Expected net per trade 0 +- 50 bp; the economics bar is likely binding.

sessions.historical: Every weekday before 2026-11-06 with a recorded alert file ai_reports/sessions/DAY/discord.jsonl.gz on the mini (about 34 sessions from mid-September), split by count in date order into EARLY and LATE halves. A session whose alert file is missing, empty before 09:15, or unreadable is excluded and counted.
sessions.forward: Every session from the first SIP morning (dry run on live SIP prints) is a separate FORWARD sample, never pooled with the historical one. It is read by the same statistic at the first close with >= 150 forward filled trades, or after 20 forward sessions whatever the count.

universe.alerts: Every line of the session's discord.jsonl.gz is a momentum alert for its symbol (the list the operator pays for). Name-day = the first alert for that symbol in the session with alert time 04:00:00-09:15:00 ET.
universe.price: Alert price = the last SIP trade at or before the alert second (at most 60 s old; else the name-day is dropped and counted). Primary band: alert price >= $2.00 (the operator's floor). Information bands: $2-5, $5-10, $10-20, $20+, and under $2 (no pass).
universe.excluded: Levered/inverse ETPs (the desk's levered_etp list), warrants/units/rights (symbol suffix W, U, R after 4+ letters with a common-stock parent), and the data guards of premarket_t1_sim amended item 4 (split jumps, corporate actions, failed batches fail closed).
universe.seats: At most 6 momentum names held in the book at once per session, admitted in alert order (ai_phase_b_max_seats 6); a seat is released when the name has used its 2 entries (ai_phase_b_max_entries_per_symbol 2) and is flat, or 75 s after its last SIP print (ai_phase_b_seat_stale_sec 75).

entry.arm: The live premarket arm as of commit 91c223c4: phase_b.phase_b_arm_allows with ai_phase_b_legacy_arm false, i.e. the shared RTH indicator gate ai_entry_watch.exhaustion_allows_buy on a record built from SIP 1-minute bars the way the desk builds it (fast %R 21/EMA 7, slow %R 112/EMA 3, previous session's 09:30-16:00 bars then today's from 04:00, the desk's own gap handling), plus the lane's session mechanics: decision minutes from the alert minute to 09:20 ET (ai_phase_b_entry_cutoff), a SIP print at most 15 s old at the decision second (ai_phase_b_print_max_age_sec), confirm ticks 1, at most 2 open positions at once (ai_phase_b_max_open), at most 2 entries per name, lockout of a name after a losing exit (ai_phase_b_lockout_on_loss). The script must import and call these functions, not reimplement them, with the config fingerprint pinned to the live values on 2026-11-06 except ai_phase_b_dry_run (irrelevant offline).
entry.decision: Evaluated on each completed minute; the decision second is the first second of the next minute. Onset only: a name that stays armed does not re-enter until it has been flat and unarmed for one minute.
entry.fill: premarket_t1_sim amended item 2 verbatim except the size: limit = min(L x 1.0015, L + $0.05) (ai_phase_b_entry_limit_pad_pct 0.15, pad max $0.05), L = last SIP trade at most 15 s old; filled if the SIP ask <= limit at the decision second, or if SIP trades strictly below the limit add up to >= the order size within 45 s (ai_phase_b_entry_limit_ttl_sec); else UNFILLED (counted). Quote usable only per amended item 3.
entry.size: $400 per trade = min(ai_phase_b_max_position_dollars $2,000, ai_phase_b_max_position_pct 4% of $10,000 equity, the 0.5% risk budget at the 5% stop = $1,000). Shares = floor($400 / limit); names where that is 0 shares are dropped and counted.

exit.primary: First of: (1) the 5% hard stop (ai_phase_b_hard_stop_pct) checked on SIP trades after the fill, exit at the SIP bid at the first quote after the trigger (gap-through: per T1 amended item 1); (2) 10 minutes after the fill, at the SIP bid; (3) the operator's liquidation at 09:25:00 ET (ai_phase_b_flatten_start), at the SIP bid at 09:25:00. Nothing is held into the 09:30 open (ai_phase_b_no_rth_handoff).
exit.information: Hold to the 09:25 liquidation (stop still active); 30-minute hold; exit at the 09:30 SIP open (what a hand-off would see; never live, per the operator 11/06 '925 is the end of pre-market for us').

costing: premarket_t1_sim amended item 1: entry at the SIP ask (or the limit when filled by later prints), exit at the SIP bid; no separate spread charge; entry and exit spreads reported separately. No commission.

controls.d: Same name, a random minute drawn uniformly from [entry - 60, entry + 60] minutes, excluding |delta| < 5, at or after the alert minute and at or before 09:20, same fill, size and exit rules, same hold length including any 09:25 truncation (seed sha256(symbol|day|entry|'MP-d')).
controls.a: Same name, buy at the decision second right after the ALERT minute (the 11/06 quick look's rule), same fill, size and exit rules. lift_a = net(arm) - net(a) per name-day that has both. Information only, no pass: it answers 'is waiting for the arm better than buying the alert'.
controls.dropping: A signal without a usable control is dropped from that lift only (counted).

statistic: Per session the mean over its filled arm trades; sessions equal-weighted; day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided bounds at 0.975, t at n-1 df.
power: Counted first, before any return is read: filled arm trades, sessions with a fill per half, and MDE per half = 3.08 x sd_session(net(d) - net(a)) / sqrt(sessions) (a placebo with no arm in it). UNDERPOWERED (no means read, historical sample closed, forward sample decides) if any of: fewer than 150 filled arm trades; fewer than 12 sessions with a filled trade in either half; MDE > 25 bp in either half.
pass: Historical PASSES only if ALL hold for the $2+ primary band: (1) mean net > 0 with t >= 2.0 over all scored sessions and > 0 in BOTH halves; (2) lift_d > 0 in BOTH halves with t >= 1.65 over all sessions; (3) economics: per session $ = sum of net_i x $400 over its filled arm trades ($0 on sessions with none); mean $/session >= $4.70 (SIP-only keep-bar, docs/SIP_MONTH_PLAN_2026-10-15.md) over ALL sessions and in BOTH halves; $9.50 (SIP + Discord at renewal) reported; (4) fill rate >= 50% of limit orders; (5) survives dropping the top 3 days and the top 5 names (each test (1) and (3) re-run).
fail: If powered: any half's mean net <= 0 = FAIL (not supported); 'refuted' only if the all-session 97.5% upper bound is < 0. Short of PASS otherwise = FAIL (not shown). On FAIL the momentum names stay dry in premarket for the whole SIP month; the forward sample is still recorded and read once, as information.
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3 on the result. Then, during a paid SIP month only, the lane runs DRY on live SIP for the first 5 sessions (forward sample starts), then live on PAPER at $400 with every live rail unchanged, decided by the operator. A historical pass alone never switches anything on, and nothing here changes the day desk's $20 floor.
forward_read: The forward sample (dry run on live SIP, then paper) is scored by the same statistic, pass bars (1), (3), (4), with fills judged offline by the same tick rule while dry. One read, at the trigger in sessions.forward. It decides whether momentum premarket earns a live paper slot (if it was dry) or keeps it (if it was on paper).
information_only: Each information price band, including under $2, with the same statistics.
Fill rate, unfilled count, entry and exit spread (median, p90) by half-hour 04:00-09:20.
lift_a (arm vs buy-at-alert), with its own day-clustered t.
Exit variants: hold to 09:25, 30-minute hold, 09:30 open.
Stop hit rate, gap-throughs, lockouts, seat-full refusals.
Arms per session and minutes from alert to arm (how long the arm waits).
Never-green share (peak < entry + 5 bp) of arm trades vs control a.
no_retuning: No other price floor, alert window, arm setting, seat or entry cap, limit pad, ttl, size, hold, stop or liquidation time is scored as primary. A config change to the premarket lane during the forward sample restarts the forward count (logged by config fingerprint in the premarket ledger).
multiplicity: One primary (the $2+ band, arm entry, 10-minute exit). Everything else is information.
canary: Before scoring, the script must recover a planted +50 bp edge on the arm trades (as harnesses-pass-planted-edge did for the day replays) within +-5 bp, and score the 'a' control on the 10/23-11/05 sessions within +-50 bp of the quick look's gross number once the cost is removed (a fill/cost sanity check, not a target).
data_budget: Free Alpaca historical SIP only (1-minute bars 04:00-09:30 plus the prior session; SIP trades and quotes around each decision and exit second), reusing the tick cache of tools/studies/momentum_alert_ticks.py (ai_reports/momentum_alerts/*.pkl) where it covers the second needed. Runs after hours at nice 19, one heavy Alpaca job at a time, never 09:00-16:30 ET.
script: tools/studies/momentum_premarket.py (count / canary / score modes) is written after a result-skeptic READY and may not change anything above.

amended.when: 2026-11-06 ~05:20 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (10 findings), before any code or data pull. Items replace the named sections.
amended.1_price_floor: Verified on the mini 2026-11-06: ai_phase_b_min_price is null, so phase_b.min_price falls back to ai_watch_min_price = $20; the live lane drops every momentum name under $20 today. The primary band STAYS alert price >= $2.00 because that is the operator's stated target (11/06 'the price is around two dollars and up'); $20+ is reported as information (the lane as it runs today). A $2+ result can only go live through an explicit ai_phase_b_min_price = 2.0 change, decided by the operator; that change is a config change under no_retuning and starts the forward count. The sentence 'nothing here changes the day desk's $20 floor' means ai_watch_min_price stays $20 for the day desk; it does not apply to the premarket lane. For the forward sample to test the primary band, the forward dry run needs ai_phase_b_min_price = 2.0 (and any upstream momentum floor that keeps $2-20 names out of gather_candidates, verified by count) from its first session; that is an operator decision at the start of the SIP month, and without it the forward sample tests only $20+.
amended.2_clock_and_state: Added to entry.arm: the script freezes time.time() at the decision second for every call (phase_b and ai_entry_watch read the wall clock, e.g. square_since and _presquare_rand_release), resets the module state of phase_b and ai_entry_watch (square/presquare streak counters, _ENTRIES_BY_DAY_SYM, _LOCKED_OUT_BY_DAY, seat state) at the start of each session, and feeds the stream-last state (fresh_stream_last) from SIP trades at or before that second. A unit test proves the same record gets the same arm verdict at two different wall-clock times. Offline isolation: ai_entry_watch._engine_indicator_map and load_watch are stubbed to return only replay-built values; the book path is redirected with phase_b.set_book_path_for_tests to a scratch dir; phase_b_ledger writes go to a scratch dir; a test asserts no file under ai_reports/phase_b_ledger or the live book path changes during a run.
amended.3_decision_cadence: Replaces entry.decision: the arm is evaluated every 5 s from the name's admission second to 09:20:00. The record is built by the desk's own live path (ai_entry_watch.live_exhaustion / phase_b.refresh_seat_indicators) from the last SIP trade at or before t and SIP 1-minute bars completed before t. Count mode lists every record field exhaustion_allows_buy reads; a field the replay cannot fill fails closed (counted). Re-entry follows the live re-arm statuses; there is no onset rule.
amended.4_exit: Replaces exit.primary: the live exit. On each SIP trade after the fill, call ai_positions.apply_local_trail and the phase_b hard-stop check with the pinned config; exit at the bid of the first usable quote after the trigger (T1 amended item 1 for gap-through), or at the 09:25:00 bid (the operator's liquidation). The 10-minute exit moves to information. All ai_positions broker/REST functions (including _rest_working_sell and any order or REST call reachable from apply_local_trail or phase_b.tick) are stubbed to raise; any such call fails the run.
amended.5_mechanics: Replaces universe.seats and the lockout/entry-count text: mechanics are the live code's - the spread gate ai_phase_b_max_spread_pct 0.75 on the SIP spread at the decision second; seats released only by staleness (ai_phase_b_seat_stale_sec 75); seat steal by source rank when seats are full, as coded; lockout only on a hard stop; an unfilled limit counts as one of the 2 entries per name (counted at submit, as live).
amended.6_alert_time: Added to universe.alerts: discord.jsonl.gz rows are OCR capture times logged before the de-duplication check. Name-day admission second = max(first alert ts, first row for that symbol with source momentum in that session's sources.jsonl.gz, which is what Phase B reads via gather_candidates) where such a row exists; if the symbol has no momentum row that session (e.g. the $20 momentum floor filtered it upstream), admission = first alert ts (counted as no_source_row, reported by price band). An alert whose exact line already appears for that symbol in the prior session's file is skipped (stale screen). Reported: overlap between alert names and momentum-source names, and each session's first-line time. A session with no alert line before 07:00 ET is excluded (counted: the recorder was not up for premarket).
amended.7_equity: Replaces the $10,000 in entry.size: equity = the account equity the Phase B sizing call receives, recorded from the mini on 2026-11-06 before any scoring and written into the result header; size = min($2,000, 4% of that equity, the 0.5% risk budget at the 5% stop) and the economics bar's dollars are recomputed from it.
amended.8_control_d: Added to controls.d (T1 amended_2 A1): d candidates are fillable seconds only (usable quote, fresh print), on the same 5 s cadence as the arm; the hold must end by 09:25:00; the control uses no seat or open slot.
amended.9_canary: Replaces the second half of canary: the canary reruns the quick look's exact rule (buy the minute after the first alert, 30-minute hold, GROSS, $2+, 10/23-11/05) and must land within +-50 bp of -366 bp; the planted +50 bp edge test stays.
amended.10_power_feed: Replaces the MDE limit in power: MDE > 15 bp in either half = UNDERPOWERED (as T1). Added: the result is on SIP only. The live lane on IEX (alpaca_bar_feed = iex) is untested by this study; a pass requires the SIP-fed stream (docs/SIP_DAY1_RUNBOOK.md) before any live use.
amended.round2: result-skeptic round 2 (2026-11-06 ~05:35 ET): FIX FIRST with three text-only fixes (A no_source_row admission + forward floor, B offline isolation, C broker stubs), applied verbatim above; the reviewer said READY with those in, no round 3.

amended_scope.when: 2026-11-06 ~12:40 ET, before any return was read and before any SIP-month forward data exists.
amended_scope.change: The HISTORICAL scored sample is replaced by COUNT-ONLY information. Reason: a faithful offline replay of the live arm needs the signal engine's indicator map (cm_rsi, pctr_slow, pctr_gap, macd, square/presquare state), which the live path reads from a separate process; reimplementing it would be a second, unvalidated arm and the skeptic's rounds 1-2 explicitly ruled that out. The pre-registered scored sample is the FORWARD sample only: the lane's own real arms recorded in the premarket ledger (entry_limit rows, dry_run true) during the SIP month, with fills and exits judged offline by the prereg's tick rules and SIP quotes. All entry, fill, exit, cost, control, pass, power and feed rules above apply unchanged to that sample.
amended_scope.count_mode: tools/studies/momentum_premarket.py count (built, tests/test_momentum_premarket_count.py): name-days per session and price band, liquidity before and after the alert, sessions excluded for a late recorder. No price change after the alert is computed. It sets the ceiling for the forward sample and informs the power rule.
amended_scope.not_built: canary and score modes of the historical replay are NOT built and will not be; the quick look in running list row 94 remains the only historical return read and is labelled as exploratory buy-at-alert.
amended_scope.forward_scorer: A forward scorer (reads the premarket ledger's dry-run arms, fetches SIP trades and quotes for each, applies fill, exit, cost and control rules) is built during the first SIP week, before the 150-fill read, and may not change anything above.
